description: This file defines data models for transactions within a finance tracking application, including classes for individual transaction items and paginated collections of these transactions.

classes.name: TransactionItem
classes.description: Represents a single income or expense transaction with fields such as id, userId, amount, type, category, date, and an optional note.

classes.name: PaginatedTransactions
classes.description: Holds a list of TransactionItem objects along with pagination metadata like total, page, and perPage.

methods.name: TransactionItem.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a TransactionItem instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: PaginatedTransactions.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PaginatedTransactions instance from a JSON map, parsing the list of TransactionItems and pagination info.
